item.tib: las kyi gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po'i bsgrub thabs
item.skt: ya ma karna Na dza d+harma sa d+ha na maH
item.coloph: las kyi gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po'i bsgrub thabs/ /slob dpon la li ta badz+ras mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /bal po thugs rje chen po dang / bod kyi ban+de rwa lo tsA ba rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur ba'o

item.tib: las kyi gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po'i bsgrub thabs zhes bya ba
item.skt: ya ma karma ra dza d+harma sa d+ha na maH
